items.title: Will Phase 3 Sjögren's Data Change Amgen (AMGN) Narrative
items.summary: Amgen reported that its Phase 3 OASIZ-301 trial for dazodalibep in Sjögren's disease met primary and key secondary endpoints, with both dosing regimens delivering clinically meaningful improvements in systemic disease activity and symptoms in a condition that currently has no FDA approved treatments. The dazodalibep data indicates potential expansion of Amgen's immunology portfolio into a sizeable unmet autoimmune niche, where a first in class CD40L antagonist fusion protein could reshape...
